newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: CZECH CNB-120 INDEX FALLS THREE POINTS TO 852.3.
newsitem.headline: CZECH CNB-120 INDEX FALLS THREE POINTS TO 852.3.

text.p: The CNB-120 index, a broad daily measure of Czech equities, fell 3.0 points on Tuesday to 852.3, the Czech National Bank (CNB) said.
Five of the ten sectoral indices lost, with the food index losing the most, down 22 points, or 2.20 percent, to 976.4 points.
Five indices rose, with the food index rising the most, up 8.8 points, or 0.73 percent, to 1,218.4.
